Verbatim actual Sonnet review of exact source cda616723c380ec59c8f548ec36b9318399a78b8:

PR #1813 is a comprehensive retirement of the `crystalball.app` domain across every security boundary reviewed. Key verified changes: (1) `isRetiredAppUrl()` / `assertActiveRequest()` guards in `src/services/runtime.ts` reject all retired host forms—including trailing-dot, mixed-case, protocol-relative, and subdomain variants—before any native fetch or cloud fallback call; (2) CORS allowlists in `api/_cors.js`, `api/_api-key.js`, `api/youtube/embed.js`, `server/cors.ts`, and `scripts/ais-relay.cjs` have all retired-domain patterns removed and emit no permissive fallback header for disallowed origins; (3) Web CSP (`index.html`) and Tauri native CSP (`src-tauri/tauri.conf.json`) remove retired-domain entries from both `connect-src` and `frame-src`; (4) Sidecar: `isRetiredRemoteBase()` added to both `proxyToCloud()` and `tryCloudFallback()`, `SIDECAR_PROD_HOSTS` removed, default `remoteBase` cleared from `https://crystalball.app` to empty, theater-posture cloud proxy removed and replaced with local computation; (5) `api/story.js` fully replaced with a 410 / `no-store` handler; `api/og-story.js` footer watermark changed from `crystalball.app` to `Crystal Ball` with PNG serving intact; (6) `ServiceStatusPanel` now records the actual resolved probe destination URL rather than hardcoding `api.crystalball.app`; (7) Public story sharing unconditionally disabled (`PUBLIC_STORY_SHARING_ENABLED = false`), all share-text paths remove retired URL references; (8) Domain-retirement suite added as four fixed frozen stages in `mcp-suite-entry.mjs`, additive to existing suites with `STAGE_TIMEOUT_MS = 150_000`, `OUTPUT_LIMIT_BYTES = 16 MiB`, and all TAP/cleanup rules preserved; (9) Four Health fixture Origin literals corrected to `http://localhost:5173`—the ACAO reflection assertion still distinguishes this allowed origin from the `tauri://localhost` fail-closed fallback; all other status/body/no-store/Host-403/preflight-204 and read-count assertions are unchanged. All 13 historical mutation proofs cover key guard clauses at their original commit. The initial Health run failed 45/2 on the two CORS fixtures (confirmed causal); after the four-literal correction Health passed 47/0 + 34/0 (outer 2/0). Version 2.25.147, stage/outer budgets, 16 MiB capture, TAP/cleanup rules, and bundle caps are unchanged. Two nonblocking findings are noted below.
